name: opennblm
author: opennbLM contributors
description: A native, voice-first AI learning companion.

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @opennblm/renderer build && pnpm --filter @opennblm/preload build && pnpm --filter @opennblm/desktop build
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:intel: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
